# googleplay_subscriptions (Data Source)

Every subscription of an app, with its base plans and the ids of their offers. Use it to find the product, base plan and offer ids a configuration refers to, and to write import blocks for what already exists: a subscription imports as `{package_name}/{product_id}`.

A read lists the subscriptions, a page of up to 1,000 per call, and then every offer of the app in a single list across all its subscriptions, again up to 1,000 per call. It reads no offer one by one.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "googleplay_subscriptions" "app" {
  package_name = "com.example.app"
}

output "subscription_product_ids" {
  value = data.googleplay_subscriptions.app.product_ids
}

# The base plans of each subscription, as product id => base plan ids.
output "base_plan_ids" {
  value = {
    for sub in data.googleplay_subscriptions.app.subscriptions :
    sub.product_id => [for plan in sub.base_plans : plan.base_plan_id]
  }
}

# Import ids for every subscription, to write import blocks from.
output "subscription_import_ids" {
  value = [
    for sub in data.googleplay_subscriptions.app.subscriptions :
    "${data.googleplay_subscriptions.app.package_name}/${sub.product_id}"
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `package_name` (String) The package name (application id) of the app, for example `com.example.app`. The app must already exist in Play Console: the API cannot create one.

### Read-Only

- `product_ids` (Set of String) The product ids of every subscription of the app.
- `subscriptions` (Attributes List) Every subscription of the app, ordered by product id. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--subscriptions))

<a id="nestedatt--subscriptions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `subscriptions`

Read-Only:

- `base_plans` (Attributes List) The base plans of the subscription, ordered by base plan id. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--subscriptions--base_plans))
- `product_id` (String) The product id of the subscription.
- `titles` (Map of String) The title of the subscription by BCP-47 language code.

<a id="nestedatt--subscriptions--base_plans"></a>
### Nested Schema for `subscriptions.base_plans`

Read-Only:

- `base_plan_id` (String) The id of the base plan.
- `billing_period_duration` (String) The billing period as an ISO 8601 duration, for example `P1M`.
- `offers` (Attributes List) The offers of the base plan, ordered by offer id. An offer imports as `{package_name}/{product_id}/{base_plan_id}/{offer_id}`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--subscriptions--base_plans--offers))
- `state` (String) The state of the base plan: `DRAFT`, `ACTIVE`, `INACTIVE` or `INACTIVE_PUBLISHED`.
- `type` (String) The kind of base plan, named as in `googleplay_subscription`: `auto_renewing`, `prepaid` or `installments`. Only an auto-renewing base plan can have offers.

<a id="nestedatt--subscriptions--base_plans--offers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `subscriptions.base_plans.offers`

Read-Only:

- `offer_id` (String) The id of the offer.
- `state` (String) The state of the offer: `DRAFT`, `ACTIVE` or `INACTIVE`.
